items.title: Spain inflation climbs to near 5%, the highest in over three years
items.summary: Spain September preliminary CPI +4.9% vs +4.6% y/y expected Prior +4.3% Spain September preliminary HICP +5.0% vs +4.9% y/y expected Prior +4.6% The breakdownThe numbers are running hotter than expected with headline annual inflation climbing to 4.9%, its highest since February 2023.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
items.summaryZh: 西班牙9月初步CPI +4.9% ，前同比+4.6%西班牙9月初步HICP +5.0% ，前同比+4.9% ，前同比+4.6%明细数据高于预期，整体年通胀率攀升至4.9% ，为2023年2月以来的最高水平。

items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the main highlight is the Spanish CPI report. Headline CPI Y/Y is expected to rise further to 4.6% vs 4.3% prior, but the focus will be on the Core measure which has ticked lower to 2.9% in the prior reading.  The market is currently pricing roughly a 31% chance of an ECB rate hike in October, so if we get hot…
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，主要亮点是西班牙CPI报告。整体CPI同比预计将进一步上升至4.6% ，而之前为4.3% ，但重点将放在核心指标上，该指标在之前的读数中已跌至2.9%。市场目前预计10月份欧洲央行加息的可能性约为31% ，所以如果我们变得火热……
